verdict.rationale: Adyen's own Management API automates terminal management: it can order terminals and accessories for delivery to a chosen location by API instead of through the Customer Area. That is one step of programmatic location provisioning, and the official OpenAPI definitions and MCP server would let an agent drive it. The pack never shows the two core steps of the story, creating a store or location via API and registering or assigning readers to it, so only a thin slice is evidenced. Missing for 10: documented API to create a store/location, documented API to register or assign terminals to that location, an end-to-end provisioning workflow, hands-on or independent corroboration.
